name: Black Chana Breakfast Sundal
steps: If using freshly cooked kala chana, drain but reserve a little cooking liquid.
Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds, curry leaves and hing.
Add turmeric and cooked chana with 1–2 tbsp reserved liquid. Toss over medium heat for 3–4 minutes.
Turn off the heat. Add lemon, coriander and optional coconut.
Taste and serve warm or at room temperature.
note: Use no coconut if avoiding it; the recipe remains satisfying with lemon and coriander.
